terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24.20.0 >/dev/null; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24.20.0)"):$PATH"; cd poc/backend && npm start'
terminals.description: NestJS PoC backend on http://127.0.0.1:3000 (OpenAPI at /docs).
